mapper.sql: select g.grant_id, g.app_user_id, g.store_id, g.city_id, coalesce(c.name,s.city) as city, g.role_code, g.also_service, g.status, g.granted_by, g.granted_time, g.revoked_by, g.revoked_time, g.del_flag, g.create_by, g.create_time, g.update_by, g.update_time, g.remark, u.nickname, u.phone, s.store_name from kg_staff_grant g left join kg_app_user u on u.user_id = g.app_user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join kg_store s on s.store_id = g.store_id and s.del_flag = '0' left join kg_city c on c.city_id = g.city_id
mapper.select: select g.grant_id, g.app_user_id, g.store_id, g.city_id, coalesce(c.name,s.city) as city, g.role_code, g.also_service, g.status, s.store_name from kg_staff_grant g left join kg_store s on s.store_id = g.store_id left join kg_city c on c.city_id = g.city_id where g.app_user_id = #{appUserId} and g.status = '0' and g.del_flag = '0' and ((g.city_id is null and s.status = '0' and s.del_flag = '0') or (g.store_id is null and g.role_code in ('city_lead','manager','keeper','online_staff','merchant_service','merchant','staff') and c.status='0')) order by g.grant_id
select * from kg_staff_grant where app_user_id=#{appUserId} and city_id=#{cityId} limit 1

select grant_id, app_user_id, store_id, role_code, status, granted_by, granted_time, revoked_by, revoked_time, del_flag from kg_staff_grant where app_user_id = #{appUserId} and store_id = #{storeId} limit 1

select count(1) from kg_staff_grant g inner join kg_store s on s.store_id = g.store_id where g.app_user_id = #{appUserId} and g.store_id = #{storeId} and g.status = '0' and g.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and s.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert:
insert into kg_staff_grant
app_user_id, store_id, city_id, role_code, also_service, status, granted_by, granted_time, create_by, remark, create_time
#{appUserId}, #{storeId}, #{cityId}, #{roleCode}, #{alsoService}, #{status}, #{grantedBy}, #{grantedTime}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, sysdate()
mapper.update:
update kg_staff_grant
role_code = #{roleCode}, also_service = #{alsoService}, status = #{status}, granted_by = #{grantedBy}, granted_time = #{grantedTime}, revoked_by = #{revokedBy}, revoked_time = #{revokedTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = sysdate()
where grant_id = #{grantId} and del_flag = '0'

update kg_staff_grant set status = '0', del_flag = '0', role_code = #{roleCode}, also_service = '0', granted_by = #{grantedBy}, granted_time = sysdate(), revoked_by = null, revoked_time = null, update_by = #{grantedBy}, update_time = sysdate() where grant_id = #{grantId}
mapper.select: select g.app_user_id from kg_staff_grant g join kg_store s on s.store_id = g.store_id where g.store_id = #{storeId} and g.status = '0' and g.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and s.del_flag = '0' and g.role_code <> 'city_lead'
select g.app_user_id from kg_staff_grant g where g.store_id = #{storeId} and g.status = '0' and g.del_flag = '0' and g.role_code = 'merchant_service'
